name: Advanced Age Verification Popup
author: Yeasin

sections.description:
Advanced Age Verification Popup is a simple, lightweight, and customizable WordPress plugin that allows you to add an age verification popup to your website. Ideal for websites selling adult products like vaping supplies, alcohol, or any age-restricted content.

Key Features

  • Yes/No Button Verification
  • Date of Birth Verification with modern Flatpickr date picker
  • Option to enable both methods
  • Custom logo upload
  • Editable text (Title, Buttons, Warning)
  • Set cookie duration
  • Redirect underage users to a custom URL
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Lightweight and fast loading
  • Flatpickr dark theme for professional look

Use Cases

  • Vape and E-Cigarette Shops
  • Alcohol and Spirits Stores
  • CBD / Cannabis Products
  • Adult Content Sites

Arbitrary section

None.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Age Verification to configure the popup.
  4. Set your logo, texts, and choose the verification method (Yes/No, Date of Birth, or Both).
  5. Save changes and you’re done!
sections.faq:
1. Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin works on all pages including WooCommerce shop and checkout pages.

2. Can I customize the popup design?

Yes, you can add your own CSS or override the plugin’s CSS from your theme.

3. Can I change the age limit from 18 to another number?

Currently, the default is 18 years, but you can edit the plugin code to change it. (A future update will add this as an admin setting.)

4. Does this plugin support translations?

Yes, it is translation-ready and supports any language.
